items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my mother was Egmas [?] [unintelligible]. Don’t try to spell it.

ctx.x: My father was Bernard Thielemans, and my mother was Egmas [?] [unintelligible]. Don’t try to spell it. [laughs] She was from Antwerp. My father was from Brussels. And there were some roots from Walloon, from the mine work. This province in Wallonia, and my uncles were mine workers. So there’s a total scope, total mixture of Belgian, Flemish, Walloon French, and Brussels. That’s so I’m three linguist to start.
So Flemish, French, and English or…
